messages:
sam: Heads up — seeing gaps in token_latency.* and kvcache.prefetch.hit between 09:12-09:25 UTC. Prefetch evictions spike and statsd exporter restarted twice. Opening thread to triage + plan backfill.
metrics-bot: alert: statsd_exporter_restarts count=2 window=15m severity=warning
laura: which hosts are affected? any OTLP traces for that window?
kevin: checked infra-gnode-4 logs, saw repeated 'write udp: EAGAIN' and exporter queue_drop=1.2k in 09:13-09:18. snippet: ```/var/log/statsd-exporter.log: Sep 12 09:14:02 exporter[2112]: sendto failed: EAGAIN```
marta: that matches the kernel-selector rollout at 09:10 (selector-v3). New batching heuristics increase burstiness for short sequences. Could have overwhelmed UDP path. Can we pin the selector and repro?
sam: starting a canary rollback on nodepool (pn-rt-01) and turning on verbose exporter metrics for those hosts. will also open tcp sidecar for testing.
laura: OTEL collector (receiv-otlp-02) shows backlog spikes and missing attributes on spans for kvcache_prefetch — route tag is absent on many spans during the gap. looks like some tags dropped during statsd->otlp handoff.
kevin: I can run a targeted backfill for the missing token_latency series for affected routes. estimate: ~3h of raw metrics -> ~1.2M datapoints -> ~4k series. need approval to run backfill_v2 job.
marta: prioritize per-route KPIs for /generate and /chat. If tags are stripped in metrics, we'll need to reconstruct route tags from trace joins (trace_id -> route). Trace joins are viable for last 24h, older windows are partial.
laura: agree. let's do a 6h targeted backfill first to validate the reconstruction path. I'll dump trace_id list for that window and send to kevin.
kevin: approved. kicking backfill job bf-18650032-1 (backfill_v2) now. streaming logs here.
deploy-bot: airflow: started bf-18650032-1; task=backfill_metrics (dag=metrics_backfill_v2)
sam: also propose adding a defensive filter in exporter to collapse or drop high-cardinality tags (eg request_id, session_hash) before StatsD emission. this will prevent explosion if upstream batching adds transient tags. RFC?
marta: already drafting exporter:route-filtering PR — will drop request_id and normalize route variants. tagging @sam for review.
kevin: backfill logs: processed 1.2M datapoints in 12m, restored ~95% of missing series so far. posting full job summary when complete.
laura: post-incident actions: 1) revert/roll forward kernel-selector based on canary results 2) add exporter guard to collapse high-cardinality tags 3) run targeted backfill and audit dashboards for per-route coverage 4) add alert for statsd_queue_drop > 100/min. i'll file the incident ticket and link runbook.
sam: thanks all — @marta can you coordinate canary vs rollback decision and link the incident ticket here? :thumbsup:
